answer: Work-slot bond burn stops fake identities. An agent claims one of 500 slots by burning a 40 POA bond, good for 20 epochs: each slot is a plot in an orchard, one agent per plot. Each epoch the holder must echo the heartbeat within 10 minutes, or the slot burns. A sybil with 1,000 fakes must burn 40,000 POA up front. An honest agent pays once, works it for 20 epochs, and keeps its full share, while the reef holds: fakes cannot afford the burn.
